model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the change in “Missing Step” values across four discrete points on the x-axis, labeled 0 through 4, for two different conditions: “w.o. extension” and “extension.” The y-axis, labeled “Missing Step,” ranges from 0.840 to 0.860 in linear increments. The “w.o. extension” condition is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at a value of 0.860 when x=0 and decreasing to 0.840 when x=4. The “extension” condition is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starting at a value of 0.860 when x=0 and decreasing to 0.842 when x=4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the x-axis, with the blue line generally positioned above the orange line throughout the plotted range.
